summary: Israeli airstrikes in Khan Younis killed three Hamas operatives emerging from a tunnel, while a major IDF operation in Hebron uncovered a 15-meter deep tunnel and displaced over 2,000 Palestinians. Iran's IRGC threatened undisclosed missiles targeting Israeli and US bases, and an Iranian MP advocated for nuclear weapon testing. Jordan conducted airstrikes in southern Syria linked to the Karak Church attack, prompting Syria to close the Nassib border crossing.

IDF discovered a 15-meter deep, 75-cm wide tunnel in Hebron near gunmen's homes, scanned 500+ buildings, displaced 2,000+ residents, apprehended 50 suspects, seized two guns. (Source: @manniefabian/59433)
Iranian IRGC spokesman threatened undisclosed missiles capable of striking Israeli territories and US bases, calling Trump a failed state president. (Source: @N12chat/231877)
Iranian MP Ahmad Naderi advocated for building and testing an atomic bomb for a decade, claiming Friday preachers and Supreme Leader representatives now agree. (Source: @shin_persian/11573)
Jordanian Air Force struck terrorist hideouts in southern Syria linked to the Karak Church attack, leading Syria to suspend traffic at the Nassib crossing with Jordan. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8933)
US Air Force tanker numbers (KC-135/KC-46) holding steady at ~193 across Europe and CENTCOM with ongoing rotations. (Source: @shin_persian/11568)

Blast reported in Strait of Hormuz near Iranian coast in Hormozgan Province; separate blast at Parchin military site east of Tehran attributed to UXO. (Source: @shin_persian/11570, @shin_persian/11567)

Defense Minister Katz denied plans to strike Iran before elections, stating Israel would respond forcefully if attacked; CNN reported Netanyahu pushed for joint US-Israeli strike but Trump refused. (Source: @manniefabian/59428, @Faytuks_Network/8923)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli airstrikes in Khan Younis killed three Hamas operatives emerging from a tunnel, while a major IDF operation in Hebron uncovered a 15-meter deep tunnel and displaced over 2,000 Palestinians. points: IRGC spokesman Ghanem Ibrahim threatened that Iran possesses undisclosed missiles capable of striking Israeli territories and US bases, declaring Tehran ready to act against its enemies and labeling Trump a failed state president. (Source: @N12chat/231877)

Iranian MP Ahmad Naderi publicly advocated for building and testing an atomic bomb for a decade, stating Friday preachers and Supreme Leader's representatives now agree, and suggested Mojtaba Khamenei's future fatwa on nuclear weapons would differ from his father's due to changed circumstances. (Source: @shin_persian/11573)

Explosions reported at Parchin military complex east of Tehran attributed to unexploded ordnance; separate blast heard in Strait of Hormuz near Hormozgan Province coast, cause unconfirmed. (Source: @shin_persian/11567, @shin_persian/11570)

Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian traveling to Moscow for meetings with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Qatari Emir, indicating high-level diplomatic engagement amid regional tensions. (Source: @shin_persian/11574)
High-level security summit between members of the Mecca Alliance and Iran reportedly taking place in Tehran, suggesting regional diplomatic efforts. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8922)

Defense Minister Israel Katz categorically denied reports of a planned Israeli strike on Iran before elections, stating Israel had no such intention but would respond with great force if attacked; CNN reported Netanyahu pushed for joint US-Israeli strike but Trump refused, citing IDF Chief Zamir's warning of election disruption. (Source: @manniefabian/59428, @Faytuks_Network/8923)
Israeli Air Force Nachshon Shavit (GLF5) SIGINT aircraft conducted electronic reconnaissance over Palestine at 38,575 feet, indicating ongoing surveillance operations. (Source: @redlinkleb/50121)

Egyptian national crossed border fence near Nitzana into Israel, apprehended by IDF; military views incident gravely and maintains heightened alert during election day, noting such crossings are rare. (Source: @manniefabian/59437, @N12chat/231868)

IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir reportedly warned Prime Minister Netanyahu that proposed military action could be misinterpreted by Iran leading to escalation; Netanyahu's office dismissed reports as fake news, but defense officials say disagreements extend to other sectors including Hebron operations. (Source: @yediotnews25/136811)

Israeli airstrike in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, targeted three Palestinian operatives emerging from a tunnel shaft on the western (Hamas) side of the Yellow Line; secondary explosions indicated weapons storage in the tunnel. (Source: @manniefabian/59435)

In Hebron, West Bank, IDF discovered an underground passageway approximately 15 meters deep and 75 centimeters wide near the home of Palestinian gunmen responsible for Friday's deadly shooting; the tunnel had no exit and an electronic device inside was seized for investigation. (Source: @manniefabian/59433)

The Hebron operation involved scans of over 500 buildings and structures, displaced over 2,000 Palestinian residents, resulted in apprehension of some 50 suspects for questioning, and seizure of just two firearms. (Source: @manniefabian/59433)

Artillery shelling reported in Wadi al-Salouqi area, with live map tracking; separate report describes heavy and continuous shelling with at least three shells landing on outskirts of a town. (Source: @redlinkleb/50159, @redlinkleb/50129)

Jordanian Air Force conducted airstrikes targeting terrorist organization hideouts in southern Syria linked to the Karak Church attack, prompting Syria to suspend passenger and commercial traffic at the Nassib border crossing with Jordan in both directions. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8933)

A ship was targeted near Basra ports in Iraq; separately, UKMTO reported a vessel on fire approximately 63 nautical miles southeast of Al-Faw, Iraq, with crew status and environmental impact unknown, authorities investigating. (Source: @shin_persian/11566, @Faytuks_Network/8927)

US Air Force tanker fleet (KC-135 and KC-46) numbers holding relatively steady at approximately 193 aircraft across Europe and CENTCOM area, with rotation of deployed airframes continuing. (Source: @shin_persian/11568)
Blast reported in Strait of Hormuz near Iranian coast in Hormozgan Province, a critical maritime chokepoint for Gulf oil shipments. (Source: @shin_persian/11570)
Iranian IRGC threats include undisclosed missiles capable of striking US bases in the region, escalating deterrence posture. (Source: @N12chat/231877)

key_developments: IDF airstrike in Khan Younis eliminated three Hamas operatives exiting a tunnel on the Yellow Line, with secondary explosions confirming weapons presence, indicating ongoing subterranean threat in southern Gaza. (Source: @manniefabian/59435)

Major IDF operation in Hebron uncovered a 15-meter deep tunnel near attackers' homes, scanned 500+ structures, displaced 2,000+ Palestinians, detained 50 suspects, but found only two weapons, suggesting limited militant infrastructure. (Source: @manniefabian/59433)

Iranian IRGC explicitly threatened undisclosed missile capabilities targeting Israeli population centers and US bases, signaling heightened deterrence posture and potential for rapid escalation. (Source: @N12chat/231877)

Iranian parliamentarian Naderi declared decade-long advocacy for nuclear weapon testing, claiming alignment with Friday preachers and Supreme Leader representatives, and predicted a revised fatwa from Mojtaba Khamenei, indicating hardening nuclear rhetoric. (Source: @shin_persian/11573)
